adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` (new file) simply re-serializes `@embedding` and does not change any state. On the client side, `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` defines a `saveChanges` action that calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` only renders the hosts table and an `addHost` button; there is no button/wiring invoking `saveChanges`. The new PUT route `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"` therefore appears unused by the added UI and currently adds an endpoint/action that performs no persistence.
